items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And I think Snub bought the last one that the factory had made before the factory went out of business.

ctx.x: Yes, sir. It's got a round bell like this. And this -- the bell's big here, and it comes up small like here, see. And it's got holes in it, see. It's got holes in it. And there's a slide that goes up, see. And it's got a crook in it, see. And they blows it and it sounds like a soprano saxophone, see. But you get your tone from sliding it up and down. And this horn must have come out, oh, back in the 20's and it never was popular, see. And I think Snub bought the last one that the factory had made before the…
